title: tny settings.json
description: User configuration for ~/.tny/settings.json. Command-line flags and environment variables override these defaults.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for validation and completion.

self_improve.description: Automatically learn bounded recovery guidance from verified tool outcomes. TNY_SELF_IMPROVE=0 or --no-self-improve disables it. No extra provider calls.

provider.description: Provider: openai, codex, grok, a configured HTTP gateway, acp or acp@NAME external agent.

model.description: Default model globally or by provider. Command-line --model wins.

models.description: Models last selected for individual providers. tny updates this map after successful use.

optimise.description: Independent prompt optimisation defaults. TNY_OPTIMISE_PROVIDER, TNY_OPTIMISE_MODEL and TNY_OPTIMISE_TIMEOUT override these; explicit optimisation options win. Project optimise.timeout_seconds overrides the user timeout default.

dictation.description: Dictation defaults (docs/dictation.md). Only normalize is configurable here; STT credentials stay per adapter.

normalize.description: Opt-in transcript normalization (ADR 0175): one structured rewrite on a small model from the STT adapter's own subscription, verified in C, with the raw transcript kept on any failure. true/false or an object; an object enables it only with enabled: true. TNY_DICTATION_NORMALIZE and tny dictate --normalize/--no-normalize take precedence.

model.description: Normalizer model, never the conversation model. A string, or per STT adapter. Defaults: codex gpt-6-luna, xai grok-4.7. TNY_DICTATION_NORMALIZE_MODEL overrides it.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the rewrite: a canonical level (off maps to none, light to low) or a provider token, or omit to send no field. A rejected value is retried once without the field. TNY_DICTATION_NORMALIZE_EFFORT overrides it.

fast.description: Codex only: send service_tier priority. Never inherited from the conversation's --fast.

timeout_seconds.description: Deadline for the whole normalization, including an effort retry.

effort.description: Reasoning effort globally or by provider. Canonical values: off, light, medium, high, xhigh, max, default; provider-advertised values are also accepted.

fast.description: Paid speed tier globally or by provider. Ultrafast requires openai, Responses, and gpt-6-astra or gpt-6.1-sol. Unsupported selections fail clearly.

image_input.description: Conversation image input per provider: true means configured, unverified (tny never checks a live entitlement); false refuses --image, read_image and attachments for that provider. Absent providers stay unknown and keep their existing explicit image behavior. Keys are canonical provider selectors. Image generation is independent and never gated by this map.

tools.description: Built-in tool profile for the native OpenAI-compatible loop. Environment TNY_TOOLS wins. Ignored by libtny, wasm.

last_provider.description: Provider most recently used. tny maintains this field; provider takes precedence when explicitly configured.

permission.description: Persistent permission rules. Tool/category keys map patterns to allow, deny, or ask.

web_search_command.description: Shell command template that provides web_search. Every {query} or {{query}} placeholder receives the percent-encoded query. The expanded command runs through the terminal tool path (workspace cwd, --ssh remote runner, 60 s timeout, bounded output). When both keys are set, web_search_command wins over web_search_url. Not available in wasm.

web_search_url.description: URL template that provides web_search. Every {query} or {{query}} placeholder receives the percent-encoded query; fetched over HTTP(S) like web_fetch.

web_search_model.description: Supported Codex model for provider-independent search-only requests. Does not change the conversation model or builtin Codex inline hosted search.

web_search_timeout_seconds.description: Total Codex search-service deadline including token refresh and streamed response, in seconds.

mcp.description: MCP client options. Import from other harnesses is off by default.

import_from.description: Opt-in list of harnesses whose documented user/project MCP configs tny may read. Empty/absent means no foreign files are opened.

acp.description: Named ACP agents. Select one with --provider acp@NAME.

ui.description: Interactive UI defaults. Leading --fullscreen/--inline and --alt-screen/--no-alt-screen flags override these for one run.

scrollback_lines.description: Maximum logical transcript lines retained for fullscreen scrolling. Applies on the next TUI launch.

tool_calls_expanded.description: Legacy fallback only when tool_call_view is absent: true means full, false means compact.

tool_call_reasons.description: Ask agents for a short 1–10 word tool-call reason. Missing reasons never prevent execution.

inline_mouse.description: Opt in to inline mouse reporting for clickable tool headings. Default false preserves native terminal wheel scrolling and selection.

tool_call_view.description: Tool display mode. Compact is one status/timing line; full shows retained inputs/outputs; hidden suppresses routine rows. Overrides legacy tool_calls_expanded.

max_tool_result_bytes.description: Byte threshold for inline tool results and file/web content. Oversized content stays recoverable through scoped reads. Workspace settings override this global default; .tny.json overrides both.

agent_presets.description: Optional global-only named agent inference presets. Explicit provider and model select independently from the conversation; credentials remain in existing provider stores. No project authority, task execution or provider I/O occurs while loading these settings.

command.description: Executable name or path. Stdio only; never evaluated by a shell.

agentPresetName.description: Task-name grammar: ASCII letters, digits, underscore, hyphen and dot; no leading dot or consecutive dots.

agentPresetText.description: Nonempty NUL-free UTF-8 text. Runtime additionally enforces at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode characters.

provider.description: Explicit existing provider/profile selector. No default, credentials or endpoint URL.

model.description: Explicit model identifier. Never inherited from the conversation.

effort.description: Optional independent reasoning effort. Omitted means the selected provider default.

task.description: Instructions-only task preset; cannot grant tools, permissions or credentials.

description.description: Optional discovery text; NUL-free UTF-8, at most 256 bytes at runtime.
